newsitem.title: INDIA: Kashmir rebels kill 3 soldiers, one army officer.
newsitem.headline: Kashmir rebels kill 3 soldiers, one army officer.

text.p: An Indian army officer, three soldiers and two suspected separatist guerrillas were killed in a gunbattle in Kashmir, an Indian defence spokesman said on Monday.

The fighting occurred late on Sunday after the army received a tip that a group of rebels were hiding in the village of Butwani, 22 km (13 miles) northeast of Srinagar, the summer capital of India's Jammu and Kashmir state, army officials said.
Soldiers cordoned off the village and launched a house-to-house search for the militants, they added.
"An army officer and three soldiers were killed when militants opened fire during a search-and-cordon operation on Sunday night at Butwani village," the defence spokesman told Reuters.
Three soldiers were wounded and two houses caught fire in the battle and were gutted, he added.
Five separatist guerrillas were killed in two different gunbattles with Indian paramilitary troops late on Sunday, police said.
More than a dozen militant groups are waging a separatist rebellion in Jammu and Kashmir, mainly Hindu India's only Moslem-majority province.
More than 20,000 people have been killed since the rebellion began in 1990 in the Himalayan region.
